dct_title_s: Mexico, Gulf of Mexico, Guajardo to Barra de Chavarria (Raster Image)
dct_description_sm: Prepared and published by the National Imagery and Mapping Agency. Depths shown by isolines and soundings. Relief shown by contours and spot heights. "From a British Admiralty and Mexican charts to 1994." "Soundings in meters." "Copyright restrictions of the country of origin continue to exist." Includes source diagram. Georeferenced nautical chart. Map no. 28330.
This map is part of a collection of scanned and georeferenced nautical charts produced by the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA).
